scroll_list.columns.name: sync
scroll_list.columns.label: Sync
scroll_list.columns.tool_tip: Checked repositories are checked and synced; unchecked ones are left as they are.

line_editor.name: repo_edit
line_editor.label: owner/repo, a repository link, a zip link, or a folder path
line_editor.tool_tip: GitHub: owner/repo or a github.com link. GitLab, Gitea/Forgejo (such as Codeberg) and Bitbucket: the repository's link. An https link to a zip file. Or the full path of a folder on this computer (Browse picks one): its files are read from disk, hidden folders such as .git left out.

button.name: browse
button.label: Browse...
button.tool_tip: Pick a folder on this computer to sync from.

combo_box.name: kind
combo_box.tool_tip: The kind of server. Auto tells it from the link; choose it for a self-hosted GitLab, Gitea or Forgejo on its own domain.

floater.text: Next owner of items synced from the selected repository:

check_box.name: perm_modify
check_box.label: Modify
check_box.tool_tip: Scripts, notecards and images synced from the selected repository can be modified by their next owner. Until you change these, new items get your default permissions.

check_box.name: perm_copy
check_box.label: Copy
check_box.tool_tip: Scripts, notecards and images synced from the selected repository can be copied by their next owner. Without copy, transfer stays on.

check_box.name: perm_transfer
check_box.label: Transfer
check_box.tool_tip: Scripts, notecards and images synced from the selected repository can be given away by their next owner.

check_box.name: images
check_box.label: Also upload images (L$)
check_box.tool_tip: PNG, JPEG and TGA files become textures. Each upload costs L$; the total is shown before you apply.

line_editor.name: prefix_edit
line_editor.tool_tip: Put in front of each repository's folder name in Scripts, for sorting. Example: ! puts the folders at the top. Changing it renames the folders.

line_editor.name: ignore_edit
line_editor.tool_tip: Files to leave out, comma separated. * matches anything, folders included. Example: *.test.*, */original/*

line_editor.name: token_edit
line_editor.tool_tip: For the selected repository's server. GitHub: a fine-grained token with read-only Contents access. GitLab: a token with read_api. Gitea/Forgejo: a token with read access to repositories. Bitbucket: username:app password. Kept in the viewer's protected store, one per server, and only sent to that server's API.

button.name: forget
button.label: Forget
button.tool_tip: Removes the token saved for the selected repository's server from this computer.

button.name: check
button.label: Check for changes
button.tool_tip: Compares the repositories, zip links and folders with the Scripts folder. Changes nothing.

button.name: check_region
button.label: Check scripts in this region
button.tool_tip: Finds scripts with the name of a repository script in the objects in this region you may modify (attachments are left out). Changes nothing.
